name: dispatch_actor_command_codes
description: Reads a command code from an unnamed routine and dispatches it through a chain of cases that update the actor's state and timer bytes, then runs a fixed countdown loop over that state. The called routines are unnamed, so the exact effect of each case is not visible.

name: call_four_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls four other routines one after another and then returns. It reads and writes no data itself.

name: forward_call_to_one_routine
description: Calls one other routine and then returns. It performs no other operations.

name: call_three_return_register_pair
description: Calls three unnamed routines in turn, then returns the two register values D0 and D1 combined as one 64-bit result.

name: dispatch_state_for_descend_text
description: Runs the same actor command dispatch as the neighbouring routines and references the text Descend, which shows the routine is tied to that message.

name: match_entry_and_select_state
description: Searches a table of nineteen entries for a match against the actor's two bytes. On a match it picks a state from the byte at offset six (values 10, 12 or 14) and stores it, and references the text Enter; otherwise it continues into the shared dispatch.

name: select_state_from_table_match
description: Compares the actor's two bytes with a table entry and, on a match, selects state 2, 3 or 7 from the stored values before continuing into the shared dispatch.

name: select_state_from_indexed_arrays
description: Compares the actor's two bytes with two arrays at a given index. On a match it selects the same state as the table-matching routines and then continues into the shared dispatch.

name: set_state_from_code_value
description: Sets the actor's state to 2 or 3 depending on whether the code byte at offset six equals 12 or 14, then continues into the shared dispatch.

name: set_state_on_code_fourteen
description: Sets the actor's state to 3 when the code byte at offset six equals 14, then continues into the shared dispatch.

name: enter_shared_state_dispatch
description: Jumps directly into the shared state dispatch block without any preparation of its own.

name: store_letter_and_check_state
description: Adds 65 to a stored index byte to form a character code, saves it in a shared variable, and then checks the actor state to pick the next value of that variable.

name: choose_state_by_stored_byte
description: Compares a saved byte with a shared variable and stores 7 when they are equal or 3 otherwise, then continues into the common state dispatch.

name: store_three_then_dispatch
description: Stores the value three in a shared variable and continues into the common state dispatch.

name: clear_state_and_run_loop
description: Clears two actor state bytes and calls three routines, then compares a code against the at-sign character to set a stored value and enters the shared dispatch after a 32-step loop.

name: handle_code_minus_eight_branch
description: Checks whether a returned code equals minus eight. If so it makes several calls and tests a shared variable against minus 98 to choose one of two calls, then sets the variable to 11.

name: test_flag_and_set_eleven
description: When the zero flag is set, compares a shared variable with minus 98 and either makes one call or sets the variable to 11, then enters the common dispatch.

name: compare_code_and_set_eleven
description: Compares a shared variable with minus 98, makes one call on a match or sets the variable to 11 otherwise, then enters the common dispatch.

name: call_four_then_set_eleven
description: Calls four routines, sets a shared variable to 11, and then runs the common dispatch.

name: advance_fire_position_four_steps
description: Checks an actor field against 22, then loops four times advancing the two position bytes within a 64-step wrap and reading a table of values. The text Fire! is referenced, so the routine is tied to a fire action.

name: advance_position_four_steps
description: Picks one of two calls from a flag byte, then advances the two position bytes four times within a 64-step wrap, reading a table on each step before entering the shared actor update.

name: step_position_and_test_table
description: Advances the two position bytes within a 64-step wrap four times, calls routines on each step, and then runs the shared actor update. It reads the same table as its neighbours.

name: run_actor_update_tail
description: Makes one call and then runs the shared actor update: the state bytes are checked, a timer is decremented and a countdown loop runs.

name: store_table_value_and_dispatch
description: Stores an index from a register, writes 244 to an output byte, reads a table entry and compares it with 60, then runs the state dispatch.

name: emit_and_clear_table_entry
description: Loads a table entry chosen by an index byte, copies it into an output byte, clears that table entry, and then runs the shared actor update.

name: write_stack_byte_then_update
description: Writes a stacked argument byte to an output byte, makes three calls, and then runs the shared actor update.

name: set_flag_ff_and_update
description: Sets a flag byte to 255, makes two calls with a branch on the result of the second, and then runs the shared actor update.

name: branch_on_zero_then_update
description: Makes two calls and branches on the zero flag, then runs the shared actor update.

name: map_code_to_output_value
description: Checks a code byte against the range 36 to 39 and maps its low two bits to an output value of 4, 8 or 12, with 0 replaced by 32. In state 1 it requires the at-sign character instead.

name: jump_into_actor_update_body
description: Jumps directly into the shared actor update body without any preparation of its own.

name: check_at_sign_then_update
description: Compares a returned code from an unnamed routine with the at-sign character and clears an output byte on a match. When a flag byte is set it masks two actor bytes to choose a table-driven path, then runs the shared actor update.

name: select_path_by_masked_bytes
description: When a flag byte is set, masks two actor bytes together and picks one of several paths that write output bytes, then runs the shared actor update.

name: classify_byte_against_sixty_four
description: Compares a byte with 64 and masks the low three bits of two actor bytes, then runs the state dispatch with cases selected by the returned command code.

name: classify_byte_and_set_output
description: Compares a byte with 64 and masks the low three bits as its neighbour does, and writes 208 to an output byte when the zero flag is clear, before running the state dispatch.

name: skip_call_then_update
description: Makes two calls and skips a third when the zero flag is set, then runs the shared actor update.

name: run_countdown_with_calls
description: Copies a count from a stored byte and counts it down, making calls on each step and an extra action when the count reaches zero, then makes a final call and returns.

name: repeat_countdown_restoring_count
description: Saves a counter byte, counts it down while making calls and writing 208 to an output byte when the count reaches zero, restores the saved counter, and then runs the state dispatch.

name: return_call_result_or_zero
description: Returns the result of one unnamed routine call unless the zero flag is set, in which case it makes two calls and returns zero.

name: call_two_then_return_zero
description: Calls two unnamed routines and returns zero.

name: classify_byte_for_gold_text
description: References the text GOLD+ and classifies a byte against 64 with bit masking, then runs the common state dispatch with the shared table handling.

name: mask_bytes_and_test_bits
description: References the text AND A and masks two stored bytes with 7 and then 3 to test bits, making calls on each match before the shared dispatch.

name: mask_low_bits_then_update
description: Masks two stored bytes with 3, calls routines when the result is non-zero, and then runs the shared actor update. It references the text AND.

name: enter_actor_update_at_top
description: Enters the shared actor update at its top label with no preparation of its own.

name: handle_plr_prompt_input
description: References the prompt text TO PLR with the options F, G, E, W and A. It compares an input code with minus 58 to update the stored cursor counters, then runs the state dispatch.

name: clear_flag_then_update
description: Clears a flag byte, makes two calls, and runs the shared actor update.

name: reset_counter_when_amount_zero
description: References the text AMOUNT. When a stored byte is zero it copies a saved counter back into the active counter, then continues into the shared update.

name: restore_counter_then_update
description: Copies a saved counter into the active counter, makes calls, and runs the shared actor update.

name: restore_counter_for_amount_entry
description: References the text AMOUNT. It tests a stored byte and, when that byte is zero, restores the saved counter and makes calls before the shared update.

name: copy_saved_counter_then_update
description: Copies the saved counter into the active counter, makes one call, and runs the shared actor update.

name: map_key_codes_to_slots
description: References the prompt text G, K, P, T. It maps input codes minus 57, minus 53, minus 48 and minus 44 to slot values 37, 38, 39 and 15, stores the chosen slot, and runs the table update and dispatch.

name: map_keys_to_slot_value
description: Maps input codes minus 53, minus 48 and minus 44 to slot values 38, 39 and 15. It then updates the chosen slot with a decimal-adjusted subtraction when the stored amount fits, and runs the shared dispatch.

name: map_pair_keys_to_slot
description: Maps input codes minus 48 and minus 44 to slot values 39 and 15, then updates the chosen slot with a decimal-adjusted subtraction and runs the shared dispatch.

name: map_key_to_slot_fifteen
description: Maps input code minus 44 to slot 15, subtracts a decimal amount from that slot when the stored amount does not exceed it, and runs the shared update.

name: enter_shared_update_tail
description: Makes one call and then enters the shared update tail with no other preparation.

name: subtract_amount_for_how_many
description: References the prompt text HOW MANY. It takes a slot index from a register and subtracts a decimal-adjusted amount from that slot when the amount is not larger than the slot value, then runs the shared update.

name: store_input_byte_in_slot
description: Stores an input byte into a slot chosen by a register index, restores the saved counter, and runs the shared actor update after one call.

name: select_weapon_slot_by_input
description: References the prompt text WHICH WEAPON. It accepts an input code from 194 to 208, converts it to a slot index, compares that slot with a stored value, and then runs the shared update.

name: decrement_selected_slot_count
description: Decrements the count stored for the selected slot when it is non-zero, restores the saved counter, and runs the shared update after one call.

name: enter_update_after_two_calls
description: Makes two calls and then runs the shared actor update.

name: select_armour_slot_by_input
description: References the prompt text WHICH ARMOUR. It accepts an input code from 194 to 200, maps it to a slot index, and when that slot count is non-zero decrements it and runs the shared update.

name: store_decremented_input_in_slot
description: Stores an input byte minus one into a slot chosen by a register index, restores the saved counter, and runs the shared update after one call.

name: call_twice_then_update
description: Makes two calls and then runs the shared actor update.

name: subtract_two_byte_bcd_slot
description: Stores an amount and a slot index, then performs a decimal-adjusted subtraction on an adjacent pair of slot bytes. It writes the result and returns zero when the amount is covered, or 255 otherwise.

name: decrement_slot_fifteen_when_active
description: In state 1 it decrements the stored count at slot 15 with decimal adjustment and sets a timer byte to 255. Otherwise it continues into the shared update with its at-sign check.

name: use_torch_count_when_present
description: References the prompt text WHOSE TORCH. When the zero flag is clear it decrements the stored count at slot 15 with decimal adjustment, sets a timer byte to 255, and then runs the shared update.

name: decrement_slot_fifteen_if_set
description: Decrements the stored count at slot 15 with decimal adjustment when it is non-zero, sets a timer byte to 255, and runs the shared update.

name: call_routine_then_update
description: Makes one call and then enters the shared actor update.

name: store_minus_one_slot_fifteen
description: Stores the input byte minus one, decimal-adjusted, into slot 15, sets a timer byte to 255, and runs the shared update.

name: transfer_gold_with_bcd_totals
description: References the prompt text Join gold to. It checks the requested amount against a stored limit, then loops over paired slot bytes adding decimal values and decrementing a count before running the shared update.

name: transfer_gold_amount_loop
description: When the requested amount does not exceed a stored limit, it loops over paired slot bytes adding decimal values, then runs the shared update.

name: accumulate_paired_slot_totals
description: Stores a value from a register and loops over paired slot bytes, adding them as decimal numbers into two totals, then runs the state dispatch.

name: call_pair_then_update
description: Makes two calls and then runs the shared actor update.

name: look_command_six_calls
description: References the prompt text Look. It makes six calls and then runs the shared actor update.

name: return_counter_times_eight
description: Returns a stored counter shifted left by three bits, which multiplies it by eight.

name: forward_argument_twice_to_routine
description: Passes its single argument twice to another routine and returns nothing.

name: allocate_block_from_free_list
description: Walks a linked list of free blocks for one of the requested size, splits off the needed units from a larger block, reduces the free count and returns the block. It returns zero when the request is not positive.

name: forward_two_arguments_to_routine
description: Passes its two arguments to another routine, repeating the second argument, and returns nothing.

name: free_block_into_free_list
description: Returns a block of a given size to a sorted free list: it adds the size back to the free count, walks the list to find its place, and merges it with a touching free block. It returns minus one when the size is not positive.

name: print_signal_status_report
description: Reads the signal bits and returns zero when the masked bits are clear. When a flag is set it outputs a caret, a D or C character, a newline and each index up to a stored count, then returns the result of a final call.

name: scan_word_table_to_sentinel
description: Sets up two output records from its arguments, loops over a word table until it reaches the sentinel value 65535, and stores a count and a result in the output record.

name: fill_digit_buffer_from_value
description: Stores a 64-bit value and a field width into a record, then loops over a digit buffer writing characters for the sign and fraction digits until the buffer is full. It finishes by writing a count and a length into the record.

name: normalize_shifted_value_and_format
description: Shifts a 64-bit value left one bit at a time, decrementing a field count until the value is normalised, then fills digit characters into the buffer and writes a final count.

name: format_digits_by_four
description: Walks a digit buffer in steps of four while decrementing a field count, writing characters until the buffer is full, then records the final count and length.

name: pad_buffer_with_zero_digits
description: Writes the zero digit character into successive buffer positions up to a width, then returns the updated pair of values.

name: write_digit_characters_into_buffer
description: Writes the current digit, offset by the ASCII zero character, into the buffer and advances the position, repeating until the buffer width is reached.

name: countdown_register_to_zero
description: Decrements a 16-bit count register until it reaches zero, then returns.

name: multiply_pair_by_ten
description: Multiplies a 64-bit value held in two registers by ten using shifts and adds, and returns the high and low words.

name: divide_pair_by_ten_steps
description: Shifts a 64-bit value left one bit at a time for 64 steps, carrying bits into a digit accumulator and subtracting ten whenever it reaches ten or more. The pair is updated in place.

name: multiply_signed_longs_by_shifts
description: Takes absolute values of two signed 32-bit operands, combines them with a 32-step shift-and-add loop, and returns the result with the combined sign. It returns zero when either operand is zero.

name: store_argument_in_global_word
description: Stores its one argument into a global word variable and returns.

name: shift_ten_set_high_bit
description: Shifts a 64-bit pair left by ten bits and sets the high bit of the result, returning zero when the value is zero.

name: pack_pair_with_high_bit
description: Clears the sign bit of a value and returns zero when it is zero. Otherwise it shifts a fraction word left by ten bits and sets the high bit of the result.

name: normalize_float_exponent
description: Normalises a floating-point style value by shifting its mantissa until the exponent is in range. It reports an underflow or overflow to a handler using codes 1 or 2.

name: pack_float_result_with_overflow
description: Shifts a mantissa right until its top bit is set, adjusts the exponent, and packs sign, exponent and mantissa. It reports overflow to a handler with code 2 when the exponent is too large.

name: report_error_one_return_zero
description: Reports error code 1 to a handler and returns zero.

name: report_error_two_max_exponent
description: Reports error code 2 to a handler and returns a value whose high word carries the all-ones exponent pattern.

name: parse_format_text_into_buffer
description: Scans a text string through a character-class table, copies characters into a buffer up to a limit of 32, and calls two routines to record the text length and output the result.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed table into a caller-supplied buffer when that pointer is set, then calls a routine through a stored pointer.

name: validate_disk_block_table
description: Sets up the disk validation state, writes a digit status character into an output buffer, and loops over the block table, calling a routine for each non-zero entry.

name: startup_open_libraries_and_run
description: Program entry point: it calls operating-system library functions through a base pointer, stores the returned library values in globals, and calls further library routines before returning.

name: release_library_resources
description: When a flag is set it calls library routines to close two libraries and then calls two further library routines, returning its first argument.

name: call_two_library_routines
description: Calls two operating-system library routines through the library base and returns.

name: open_dos_library_or_cleanup
description: References the text dos.library and opens it through the exec base. A non-zero result is returned; otherwise it releases resources and returns 100.

name: parse_command_line_arguments
description: Scans the command line text, storing quoted arguments as pointers up to 32 entries. It then opens the input and output handles, sets flag bits in a global byte and calls a routine with the argument count.

name: allocate_tracked_memory_block
description: Allocates the requested number of bytes plus a twelve-byte header from the operating system, records the size in the header, links the block into a list, and returns the address after the header. It returns zero when allocation fails.

name: allocate_or_return_minus_one
description: Calls the tracked allocation routine and returns its pointer, or minus one when that routine returns zero.

name: return_minus_one_constant
description: Returns the value minus one and does nothing else.

name: free_all_tracked_blocks
description: Walks the linked list of tracked blocks, freeing each one with its recorded size through the operating system.

name: link_node_at_list_tail
description: Links a new node at the end of a list described by a head record. It sets the new node's back pointer, updates the previous last node, and sets the head when the list was empty.

name: examine_file_and_set_flags
description: Locks a named file and examines it. When the examine succeeds it copies the file size field, unlocks the file, and stores flag bits in a global byte before calling a routine.

name: write_buffer_by_file_mode
description: Calls a routine and, when it returns a non-zero length, opens a named file in one of two modes, seeks, writes the buffer and closes the file. It then sets the global flag bits and returns the write result.

name: swap_view_buffers_and_load
description: Swaps four stored view pointers pairwise, loads a graphics view, and sets the global flag bits before calling routines to finish.

name: open_screen_and_libraries
description: Opens a library and fills a set of screen and window parameter records, including a 300 by 100 size, then opens a file and records its handle before returning.

name: initialize_actor_defaults_and_dispatch
description: Finds the current task, clears its signal field, and stores a set of default values into the actor record. It then dispatches on command codes such as 193 and the codes that follow it.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Stub: the decoder ran into bad instruction data after one exclusive-or on a word, so the routine has no usable behaviour.

name: loop_four_rows_setting_position
description: Loops four times, setting two actor bytes from the loop index and a fixed value of 30, and calling routines on each pass.

name: wait_until_output_sentinel
description: Clears two actor counters, then repeatedly calls a routine until an output byte equals 199 or 208, decrementing a count on each pass. It then dispatches on command codes.

name: select_actor_state_from_flags
description: Clears a direction byte and, depending on the actor state byte, sets a timer value and dispatches on the returned command code. It checks for minus eight and minus 98 as the other routines do.

name: run_update_after_empty_stub
description: Makes three calls, one of which is an empty stub, then runs the shared actor update with its countdown loop.

name: toggle_bit_zero_then_update
description: Flips bit zero of a shared flag byte and then runs the shared actor update.

name: toggle_bit_one_then_update
description: Flips bit one of a shared flag byte and then runs the shared actor update.

name: switch_on_command_byte
description: Stores a value into an actor byte and dispatches through a switch on the input byte offset by 63. It chooses among several handlers and writes output codes such as 244 to the output buffer.

name: call_pair_with_empty_stub
description: Makes two calls, one of which is an empty stub, then runs the shared actor update.

name: call_pair_before_update
description: Makes two calls and then runs the shared actor update.

name: call_pair_before_dispatch
description: Makes two calls and then runs the shared dispatch.

name: copy_saved_block_to_output
description: Calls a routine and, when the negative flag is set, saves the source pointer and count into a table and advances a global counter. Otherwise it reloads the saved block, then copies it byte by byte into the output buffer.

name: copy_output_to_saved_block
description: Makes two calls and, when the negative flag is clear, copies bytes from the output buffer back into the saved block using its recorded length.

name: find_key_in_table
description: Scans a zero-terminated table of 32-bit entries for the value in a register and returns when it finds a match or an empty entry.

name: blit_bitmap_via_graphics
description: Calls the graphics library's bit-map blit routine through the library base and returns.

name: init_rastport_via_graphics
description: Calls the graphics library's rastport initialisation routine through the library base and returns.

name: merge_copper_lists_via_graphics
description: Calls the graphics library routine that merges copper lists, through the library base, and returns.

name: make_viewport_via_graphics
description: Calls the graphics library routine that builds a viewport, through the library base, and returns.

name: free_sprite_via_graphics
description: Calls the graphics library routine that frees a sprite, through the library base, and returns.

name: clear_twenty_table_entries
description: Calls a routine to obtain each of twenty indices and passes each index to another routine to clear its entry. It then repeats over the stored count and makes a final call with its two arguments.

name: copy_scroll_field_around_call
description: Copies one stored value into a second stored field, makes a call, and then copies a different stored value into that field before returning.

name: scroll_raster_region
description: Calls the graphics library's scroll-raster routine with a fixed region, offset and size, then returns.

name: return_fixed_word_constant
description: Returns a fixed 32-bit constant and does nothing else.

name: return_constant_if_call_zero
description: Calls one routine and returns the fixed 32-bit constant when its result is zero, otherwise zero, passing the second argument through.

name: return_constant_with_stack_arg
description: Returns the fixed 32-bit constant paired with its stack argument.

name: poll_mouse_and_keyboard_input
description: Reads the keyboard serial register and the mouse port movement register, updates the sprite pointer and a pair of stored position values, and returns zero.

name: set_shared_word_all_ones
description: Sets a shared 16-bit word to 65535, with all bits set.

name: clear_shared_word
description: Clears a shared 16-bit word to zero.

name: find_byte_index_in_table
description: Searches up to 62 bytes of a table for the byte in a register and returns its position as a word, or zero when there is no match.

name: set_record_pointer_by_index
description: Computes a record address from a 16-bit index and a record size of 76 bytes, stores it as the active record pointer, then waits in a loop on that address.

name: call_auto_request_routine
description: Calls the library's auto-request routine through the library base and returns.

name: run_setup_sequence_then_poll
description: Makes calls in a counted loop of seven passes, sets two global values, makes further calls, and then repeats one call while an unnamed routine returns one.

name: setup_audio_channel_zero
description: Sets audio channel zero's length to 1 and its volume to 64, points its sample pointer at a global buffer, clears a counter, and writes the DMA control register to enable the channel.

name: run_channel_sweep_with_dma
description: Sets two channel timing values, runs a loop that steps a value up by four until it wraps to zero and calls a routine on each step, then writes the DMA control register.

name: run_channel_sweep_step_two
description: Sets channel timing values to 88 and 7, runs a loop that steps a value up by two until it wraps to zero, then writes the DMA control register.

name: call_routine_then_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns; it does no other work.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns; it does no other work.

name: wrapper_call_routine_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns; it does no other work.

name: draw_table_pixels_with_pen
description: Sets the drawing pen to 1, then loops 265 times over a table of coordinate pairs, calling drawing routines with each pair, and returns the result when a flag is set.

name: write_pixel_via_graphics
description: Writes one pixel through the graphics library's write-pixel routine and returns.

name: draw_offset_grid_pattern
description: Runs nested loops over a table of counts, calling a routine three times per step and adjusting two stored offsets by an alternating sign step. It makes final calls and then offsets one value by minus two.

name: set_offsets_from_table_entry
description: Reads an entry from a table at an index register and stores it, with an offset of 90, in one stored word. It stores a second table value with an offset of 16 in another word, then makes a call.

name: scale_input_until_flag_set
description: Multiplies a 16-bit input by 300, then decrements the result until a flag byte has its top bit set. It clears that bit and returns the result.

name: copy_block_into_four_bitplanes
description: Copies a rectangle of bytes one row at a time into four bitplane regions spaced 8000 bytes apart, with a row stride of 40 bytes.

name: fill_four_bitplanes_with_value
description: Fills four bitplane locations spaced 8000 bytes apart with a single value over a counted run, advancing through the rows until the count runs out.

name: pass_through_routine_result
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns the two register values unchanged.

name: forward_register_pair_result
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns the two register values unchanged.

name: blit_then_wait_for_frame
description: Blits a bitmap through the graphics library and then waits for the top of the next video frame.

name: blit_wait_for_frame_top
description: Blits a bitmap through the graphics library and then waits for the top of the next video frame.

name: blit_frame_then_wait
description: Blits a bitmap through the graphics library and then waits for the top of the next video frame.

name: run_timed_draw_loop
description: Sets a drawing mask and two colour register values, then repeats a loop of calls, counting steps in a stored word, until an unnamed routine returns a flag. It then restores the saved word.

name: show_press_space_title_loop
description: References the title text PRESS SPACE and ULTIMA III. It sets colour register values, then loops stepping a counter and making calls until an unnamed routine returns a flag, and finally makes further calls.

name: call_three_routines_and_return
description: Calls three unnamed routines in turn and returns; it does no other work.

name: adjust_bytes_wait_for_frame
description: Adds 96 to each table byte whose value lies between 32 and 63 and has its top bit set, copies rows of data with a stride of 640 bytes, then waits for the top of the frame.

name: copy_sixteen_words_to_bitplanes
description: Copies sixteen words from a table entry chosen by a register index into four bitplane rows, starting at offset 326 and advancing 40 bytes per word.

name: play_sound_on_channel_three
description: When a flag bit is set, it picks a sample table by a sound code and writes the channel-three sample pointer, length and period registers from that table. It then writes a value of 8 to a second register.

name: busy_wait_delay_loop
description: Stores a value into a channel register and then runs a nested busy loop of 10000 iterations for each count in a register, as a timing delay.

name: toggle_channel_flag_set_registers
description: Flips bit zero of a shared flag byte and writes the value 1024 into one channel register. On the other branch it also writes 8 to another register.

name: set_channel_register_defaults
description: Writes the value 8 to one stored word and the value 1024 to two other stored words, then returns.

name: install_interrupt_and_build_table
description: Installs a handler in interrupt vector 10, makes two calls, clears a word, fills a table of words from a source table, and sets bit zero of a stored byte.

name: repeat_call_sixteen_times
description: Calls one unnamed routine sixteen times and then returns.

name: reset_audio_channels_zero_two
description: Points audio channels zero, one and two at a global sample buffer, sets their length registers to 128, clears their volume registers, and stores 63 in two stored values.

name: call_if_flag_bit_seven
description: Calls one unnamed routine when the top bit of a shared flag byte is set, then returns.

name: process_sound_command_table
description: Steps through a sound sequence table. For each command it checks a code range, handles the special code 129 by calling an unnamed routine for a value, and updates the stored channel pointers and periods.

name: read_table_byte_and_advance
description: Reads a byte from a table at the index held in a stored word, advances that index by one and returns the byte.

name: find_matching_slot_index
description: Searches eight entries for one whose byte matches two bytes of the actor record, and returns its index, or 255 when none matches.

name: step_position_until_bounds
description: Adds two velocity bytes to two position bytes while both stay below 11, writing an output byte from a stored value on each step. It returns the result of an unnamed routine when that result is non-negative, otherwise 255.

name: set_direction_from_command_code
description: Reads command codes from an unnamed routine and maps the codes minus 127, minus 118 and minus 107 to movement direction values, then updates the position bytes from the direction.

name: read_direction_code_until_match
description: Loops reading command codes, sets direction bytes for the codes minus 127, minus 118 and minus 107, and returns after updating the position bytes.

name: apply_velocity_to_position
description: Adds the two velocity bytes to the two position bytes.

name: sign_of_byte_value
description: Returns 0 for a zero byte, 1 for a positive byte and 255 for a negative byte.

name: sign_of_byte_shifted_two
description: Returns 0 when the byte shifted left by two bits is zero, 1 when that shifted value is positive, and 255 when it is negative.

name: empty_return_routine
description: Does nothing and returns.

name: lookup_table_by_scaled_index
description: Computes a table index from one actor byte multiplied by 11 plus another actor byte, and returns the table entry at that index.

name: validate_move_code_for_state
description: Returns zero when the input code is allowed for the actor's current state byte, and 255 when it is not. For states from 22 to 31 only the code zero is valid; for other states the codes 2, 4, 6 and 16 are valid.

name: check_move_code_and_act
description: Returns 255 unless the input code is 2, 4, 6 or 16. For those codes it makes one call and returns zero.

name: search_grid_for_best_position
description: Repeatedly steps a row index up to a stored limit and makes calls for each cell, recording the best row, column and direction values in stored bytes before repeating.

name: restore_saved_row_index
description: Copies a saved row index byte into the active index byte.

name: map_key_code_to_character
description: Maps a stored key code to a printable character code from a small set of cases, returning 40, 42, 46 or 126 for matched keys and 44 by default.

name: map_stored_key_to_character
description: Maps the stored key code at a fixed offset to a printable character code, using the same case table as its neighbour and returning 44 by default.

name: replace_glyph_letters_buffer
description: Scans a 32-byte buffer, replaces each letter L or H with the value 192, and then runs the shared update.

name: run_movement_codes_loop
description: Saves the state byte, sets it to 128, and loops over a count of movement steps. It handles codes such as 138 by moving the position with a direction table and checking the result, then runs the shared update.

name: pick_positions_and_dispatch_codes
description: Repeatedly picks a position from a byte source masked to the range 0 to 7, then switches on command codes such as 195, which sets a stored byte to 120. It calls an empty stub in one branch.

name: xor_key_into_stored_bytes
description: Reads a 32-bit key from a routine, saves it, and XORs its four bytes into eight stored byte locations at fixed positions, then returns zero.

name: forward_single_call_return
description: Makes one unnamed call and returns.

name: emit_characters_until_terminator
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string. A byte of minus one makes one call and advances the pointer; any other byte makes a call, increments a stored counter and advances the pointer, until the terminating zero byte.
